references.text: The command that all men must appear before the Lord's presence three times a year at the place he chooses
The place the Lord chooses to have his name dwell there
Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests and the elders of Israel
Joshua read aloud all the words of the law to the entire assembly of Israel, including women, children, and foreigners
Ezra read from the Book of the Law before all the people who had gathered, and they listened attentively
Three times a year all men must appear before the Lord, before the Lord's presence
Three times a year all men must appear before the Lord, before the presence of the God of Israel
The people shall gather to hear and learn to fear the Lord and keep all the words of the law
